project.name: QLPK-SaaS
project.status: Production Ready Hardened Infrastructure with Debounced Prescription Search & UI Enhancements

tech_stack.frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion 12
tech_stack.ai: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (Two-Step Architecture: Search + Format)

security_status.rls: Enabled on all major tables, including clinics and stats
security_status.secrets: Hardcoded passwords removed, using .env and GitHub Secrets
security_status.multi_tenancy: Strict clinic_id filtering enforced in all statistics server actions

ux_features.pediatric_focus: Hierarchical age-based dosage, Priority rendering for children.
ux_features.dashboard_performance: Sub-100ms dashboard stats loading via clinic_daily_stats rollup.
ux_features.patient_ui: Debounced medication history search (300ms), tooltip patient names, hover row states, and smart click-propagation prevention for phone calling.

api_endpoints.description: Thống kê tổng quan và doanh thu phòng khám.
api_endpoints.security: Clinic-level isolation via clinic_id filter and RLS.

api_endpoints.description: Tra cứu liều dùng thuốc bằng AI với bảo mật chống Prompt Injection.

gotchas.issue: Multi-tenancy Data Leak in Aggregate Queries
gotchas.solution: Always include .eq('clinic_id', clinicId) even if RLS is enabled, to ensure query plan optimization and defense-in-depth.
Use dayjs.tz with 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' for start-of-month calculations to avoid 7-hour delay in reports.

gotchas.issue: PostgREST String Return for Numeric Aggregates
gotchas.solution: Wrap sum/revenue results in Number() to avoid hydration errors or chart crashes in Next.js.

gotchas.issue: Click Event Bubbling on Table Rows with Links
gotchas.solution: Use e.stopPropagation() on links (like tel:) nested in clickable table rows to prevent triggering parent navigation events.
